subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: This 5-day tour flies Juneyao Airlines from Manila to Shanghai during the Spring Festival period. You see Nanjing Road, the Bund, Zhang Garden and Xinchang Ancient Town, then Hangzhou’s Grand Canal, Gongchen Bridge and West Lake. A special Chinese New Year activity has you write Spring Festival couplets and make dumplings for lunch. Day 4 is free, with optional Shanghai Disneyland. Hotels are 4-star, and the programme includes several shop stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 2–6 2027 to Feb 9–13 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, lined with stores and neon lights.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Zhang Garden: A historic garden in Shanghai, visited on the first day.
placeDesc.Xinchang Ancient Town: An old water town near Shanghai, visited on the afternoon of arrival.
placeDesc.The Grand Canal (Hangzhou): The Hangzhou section of China's historic Grand Canal.
placeDesc.Gongchen Bridge: A historic arched stone bridge over the Grand Canal in Hangzhou.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous lake, a UNESCO World Heritage cultural landscape; wintersweet blooms in season.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Garden: A tea village near West Lake in Hangzhou with a hanfu experience and Chinese New Year activities.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple Business Area: The City God Temple area in old Shanghai, with traditional buildings and shops.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland (optional): A full-day theme park outing offered on the free day for USD 140 per person (min. 10 travellers).
placeDesc.Xintiandi (optional): A Shanghai lifestyle district of restored stone-gate houses, part of the USD 60 optional Day 4 tour.
